cases.request: Help me calculate a loan. Use INR 240000, 5% annual interest, 30 years, monthly payments and no fees. I want to explore different amounts and rates.

reply.source:
root = Root([intro, amount, rate, term, monthly, interest, total, note])
intro = Text("Loan calculator · INR · Monthly payments. Adjust the amount, annual rate, or term to recalculate instantly.")
amount = Number("amount", "Loan amount", 0, 10000000, 1000, 240000, "INR")
rate = Number("rate", "Annual interest rate", 0, 30, 0.1, 5, "%")
term = Number("years", "Loan term", 1, 50, 1, 30, "years")
monthly = Metric("Monthly payment", "@Payment($amount,$rate,$years)", "INR")
interest = Metric("Total interest", "@Payment($amount,$rate,$years)*$years*12-$amount", "INR")
total = Metric("Total repaid", "@Payment($amount,$rate,$years)*$years*12", "INR")
note = Text("Assumptions: fixed annual interest rate, interest calculated monthly at the annual rate ÷ 12, equal end-of-month payments, and no fees or extra payments. Totals use unrounded payments; actual lender rounding may differ.")
reply.fallback:
For a ₹240,000 loan at 5% annual interest over 30 years (360 monthly payments), assuming a fixed rate, monthly interest at 5% ÷ 12, equal end-of-month payments, and no fees:

• Monthly payment: ₹1,288.37
• Total interest: ₹223,813.88
• Total repaid: ₹463,813.88

Adjust the loan amount, annual interest rate, or term in the calculator to explore scenarios. Totals use unrounded payments; actual lender rounding may differ.

cases.request: Help me plan a weekend trip from Kochi to Munnar. I have not chosen the dates yet. Budget INR 15000 for two adults. Ask me only what you need before making the plan.

reply.source:
root = Root([intro, timing, departure, returnDate, nights, transport, submit])
intro = Text("Kochi → Munnar · 2 adults · Total budget ₹15,000. Before I plan, I only need your trip length, transport preference, and any date constraints. Leave the calendars blank if you’re flexible.")
timing = Select("date_flexibility", "Dates", ["Flexible—no dates chosen", "I have a preferred weekend"], "Flexible—no dates chosen")
departure = DateInput("departure_date", "Departure date (optional)", "", false)
returnDate = DateInput("return_date", "Return date (optional)", "", false, "departure_date")
nights = Select("trip_length", "How long would you like to stay?", ["Not sure—suggest what fits the budget", "1 night", "2 nights"], "Not sure—suggest what fits the budget")
transport = Select("transport", "Transport preference", ["Recommend a budget-friendly option", "Own car", "Hired car with driver", "Bus / public transport"], "Recommend a budget-friendly option")
submit = Submit("Plan our weekend", "Create a Kochi-to-Munnar weekend plan for two adults within a total INR 15000 budget, using my trip length, transport preference and date flexibility. Clearly label any assumptions.")
reply.fallback:
For your Kochi–Munnar weekend for two adults within ₹15,000, I only need:
1. Would you prefer 1 night or 2 nights, or should I suggest what fits the budget?
2. Will you use your own car, hire a car with a driver, take public transport, or would you like me to recommend an option?
Dates can stay flexible. If you have a preferred weekend, you can optionally choose departure and return dates.

values.trip_length: Not sure—suggest what fits the budget

cases.request: These are sample expenses: Lunch 100 Food, Bus 30 Travel, Dinner 200 Food. Help me explore them by category with a table and chart.

reply.source:
root = Root([intro, category, expenses, chart, totals])
intro = Text("Sample expenses by category. Choose a category to filter both the table and chart. Amounts are shown without a currency because none was supplied.")
category = Select("category", "Category", ["All", "Food", "Travel"], "All")
expenses = Table(["Expense", "Category", "Amount"], [["Lunch", "Food", "100"], ["Bus", "Travel", "30"], ["Dinner", "Food", "200"]], "category", 1)
chart = Chart("Sample expense totals by category", "bar", [{label: "Food", value: 300, category: "Food"}, {label: "Travel", value: 30, category: "Travel"}], "category")
totals = Text("Category totals: Food 300; Travel 30. Overall total: 330 across 3 sample expenses.")
reply.fallback:
## Sample expenses

| Expense | Category | Amount |
|---|---|---:|
| Lunch | Food | 100 |
| Bus | Travel | 30 |
| Dinner | Food | 200 |

Chart totals: Food **300**; Travel **30**.

**Overall total: 330** across 3 sample expenses. No currency was supplied. The interactive category selector filters both the table and bar chart.

cases.request: Compare only these SAMPLE phones: A price INR30000 battery score8 camera score6; B price INR40000 battery score6 camera score9; C price INR50000 battery score9 camera score8. Let me adjust budget and rank by battery or camera without another request.

reply.source:
root = Root([intro,budget,rank,phones])
intro = Text("SAMPLE phones only. Adjust the budget to show phones at or below it, and choose a score to rank highest first. Changes happen locally without another request.")
budget = Number("budget","Maximum budget",0,60000,1000,50000,"INR")
rank = Select("ranking","Rank by",["Battery score","Camera score"],"Battery score")
phones = Table(["Phone","Price (INR)","Battery score","Camera score"],[["A","30000","8","6"],["B","40000","6","9"],["C","50000","9","8"]],{maxField:"budget",maxColumn:1,sortField:"ranking"})
reply.fallback:
SAMPLE data only:
| Phone | Price (INR) | Battery score | Camera score |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| A | 30,000 | 8 | 6 |
| B | 40,000 | 6 | 9 |
| C | 50,000 | 9 | 8 |

At the initial INR 50,000 budget, battery ranking is C, A, B; camera ranking is B, C, A. The interactive controls filter phones at or below your budget and rank by your selected score, highest first, without another request.
